entities.name: FbpC ABC ATPase
observations: 348 aa bacterial ABC-transporter nucleotide-binding protein; exact full-length sequence match to UniProt P37009 from Escherichia coli K-12.
Contains ABC_tran domain PF00005 at positions 23–164 and TOBE_2 domain PF08402 at positions 273–344.
Curated homologs assign it as the ATP-binding component of the FbpABC ferric-iron import complex.
Reference EC number is 7.2.2.7; Rhea reaction mapping is RHEA:12332.

entities.name: Ferric iron ABC import
observations: RHEA:12332: Fe(3+)(out) + ATP + H2O = Fe(3+)(in) + ADP + phosphate + H(+).
The ATPase hydrolyzes ATP to drive ferric-iron translocation; the protein itself is the energy-coupling subunit, not the membrane-spanning transport pore.

entities.name: FbpABC ferric iron import
observations: The FbpABC complex contains two FbpC ATP-binding subunits, two membrane proteins, and an iron-binding solute-binding protein.
FbpC is a peripheral inner-membrane component that supplies energy to the transporter.

entities.name: FbpC sequence properties
observations: Sequence length 348 aa; calculated molecular mass 39,058 Da; theoretical pI 5.75.
These are sequence-derived estimates and do not account for modifications or oligomerization.
